say:4:1810402004:1.text: Good thing you weren't infected for long, or the antidote wouldn't have kicked in so fast.
say:4:1810402004:1.source_cn: 所幸你感染赤烛蕊的时间不长，解药才能这么快地起效。

say:5:1810402005:1.text: You should thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without him, Her Ladyship would never have given us the antidote.
say:5:1810402005:1.male: You should thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without him, Her Ladyship would never have given us the antidote.
say:5:1810402005:1.female: You should thank <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without her, Her Ladyship would never have given us the antidote.

say:8:1810402009:1.source_cn: 咳，婆婆，艾芙琳也需要治疗——

say:9:1810402010:1.text: That's enough talking. You should rest.
say:9:1810402010:1.source_cn: 行了，少说点话吧，你还需要静养。

say:11:1810402012:1.text: Lie down! Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought back enough antidote for two.
say:11:1810402012:1.male: Lie down! Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought back enough antidote for two.
say:11:1810402012:1.female: Lie down! Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brought back enough antidote for two.

say:12:1810402013:1.text: Once Rain settles back down, Baba Muriel immediately draws the curtain around his bed.
say:12:1810402013:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆简单交代几句，就把里纳所在的床铺帘子拉上了。

say:13:1810402014:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, honestly, I don't think I could've gotten the antidote without your help...
say:13:1810402014:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, honestly, I don't think I could've gotten the antidote without your help...
say:13:1810402014:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, honestly, I don't think I could've gotten the antidote without your help...

say:16:1810402016:1.text: Hmph, I just can't afford to lose a good helper. Rain's a lot less trouble than most Graveborn.
say:16:1810402016:1.source_cn: 哼，他只是个跑腿的，比平常亡灵员工乖顺。
say:16:1810402016:1.male: Hmph, I just can't afford to lose a good helper. Rain's a lot less trouble than most Graveborn.
say:16:1810402016:1.female: Hmph, I just can't afford to lose a good helper. Rain's a lot less trouble than most Graveborn.

say:17:1810402017:1.text: Getting around isn't easy for me these days. Without him, I couldn't keep up with the workload.
say:17:1810402017:1.source_cn: 老身身体不便，没有他帮忙做不来那么多生意。
say:17:1810402017:1.male: Getting around isn't easy for me these days. Without him, I couldn't keep up with the workload.
say:17:1810402017:1.female: Getting around isn't easy for me these days. Without him, I couldn't keep up with the workload.

choice:15:0:1.text: You really care about Rain, huh?
choice:15:0:1.male: You really care about Rain, huh?
choice:15:0:1.female: You really care about Rain, huh?

choice:15:1:2.text: I thought Rain was just your errand boy.
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 我以为你只把他当个跑腿员工
choice:15:1:2.male: I thought Rain was just your errand boy.
choice:15:1:2.female: I thought Rain was just your errand boy.

say:19:1810402007:1.text: If you had a tail, it would definitely be wagging right now.
say:19:1810402007:1.male: If you had a tail, it would definitely be wagging right now.
say:19:1810402007:1.female: If you had a tail, it would definitely be wagging right now.

choice:7:1:2.text: Keep it coming! I love being the hero!
choice:7:1:2.male: Keep it coming! I love being the hero!
choice:7:1:2.female: Keep it coming! I love being the hero!

say:20:1810402008:1.text: Hmph, nice try, but that's a separate matter. A debt's a debt.
say:20:1810402008:1.source_cn: 哼，一码归一码，该还的债还是要还。
say:20:1810402008:1.male: Hmph, nice try, but that's a separate matter. A debt's a debt.
say:20:1810402008:1.female: Hmph, nice try, but that's a separate matter. A debt's a debt.

choice:7:2:3.text: Is the antidote enough to clear my debt?
choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 这能抵消修缮屋的欠债吗？
choice:7:2:3.male: Is the antidote enough to clear my debt?
choice:7:2:3.female: Is the antidote enough to clear my debt?
